name: Muthoot Finance Ltd.
about: Muthoot Finance Limited, a non-banking financing company, provides gold loans in India. The company offers various loans, including personal, small business, home, corporate business, SME, and vehicle loans, as well as loans against property; insurance products, such as health, home, vehicle, life, travel, shop, bike, and group insurance; housing and micro finance; and mutual funds. It also provides PAN card services; money transfer; non-convertible debentures; national pension scheme; digital and cashless payments; bank mapping; milligram rewards; WhatsApp services; and other custom offerings. In addition, the company generates electric power through three windmills with a combined capacity of 3.75 MW in Tamil Nadu. verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~-3% a year growth, below the ~25% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 9 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 18), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 9 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 29 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 42% a year while PE moved 12 → 9.
